name: Dollarwise: Budget & Tracking
description:
Dollarwise is your path to stress-free budgeting.

See your spending at a glance, stay on budget with ease, and break free from overwhelming charts and scary alerts.

Dollarwise automatically syncs with your accounts, allowing you to stay on top of your spending, debt, and savings without the anxiety of manual tracking (unless you prefer to!).

But that's just the start.

Dollarwise goes further than simply showing you where your money went. When you open the app, you'll instantly see exactly how much money you are free to spend, while still staying perfectly on track with your bills, debt, and savings. (Let's be honest, that's the main reason you need a budgeting app in the first place.)

Our mindful AI learns your money habits, offering gentle, actionable insights to help you make better choices for you instead of forcing you into a one-size-fits-all box.

When it's time to review your spending, simply swipe transactions into basic buckets like Needs, Wants, and Debt/Savings. Need more flexibility? You can now create custom categories to tailor your budget exactly to your lifestyle.

Dollarwise makes it easy to see your money clearly and takes the anxiety out of budgeting.

Ready to find your financial zen? Try Dollarwise FREE for 3 days, then unlock 3 months for just $9.99/month.
